title: Oily Creamy Norwegian Mozzarella Casserole
description: A rich and creamy Norwegian dish featuring mozzarella, ferment-kimchi, and dash-friendly ingredients, perfect for a lazy Sunday. This casserole is a hearty and satisfying meal that combines the flavors of Norway with a twist of Korean kimchi.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, cook the ground beef over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until it is translucent.
Stir in the melted butter, salt, and black pepper.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked ground beef mixture, shredded mozzarella cheese, and chopped ferment-kimchi.
In a separate bowl, mix the flour and milk until smooth, then add it to the ground beef mixture and stir until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and bake for 35 minutes.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
